item.title: Historic Reflection: 1955 – Carroll Ames Fire (Bryan, Ohio)
item.description: Fire destroyed the Carroll-Ames Hardware building on the west side of the square in Bryan. Construction of the 66-feet-wide, 16,500-square-feet, three-story building began in July 1911. In March 1912, Earl C. Carroll and Bert W. Ames opened the Carroll-Ames Hardware in one of the building’s first-floor storefronts.
